name: macOS Defender Check
description: macOS Defender Check is a testing toolkit for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on macOS. It validates MDE installation and health, tests Tamper Protection and Web Protection across multiple browsers, and supports custom URL indicators with CSV import. The suite produces detailed logs and CSV reports to aid pre- and post-deployment validation, troubleshooting, and compliance auditing.
author: Niklas Bruhn

securityCheck.aiSummary: The Defender Check script is largely benign with respect to security, intended as a tamper protection test for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on macOS. However, two notable concerns exist: (1) sensitive Org ID is logged locally which could expose tenant information if logs are not protected; (2) the tamper test can attempt to disable Real-Time Protection, which could be misused or become a risk if not properly controlled. No obfuscation, remote code execution, credential theft, data exfiltration to external endpoints, or hardcoded secrets were found.
